decisions_for_board: Assign a board member to review the acknowledgment drafts and decide, if appropriate, which to send.
Determine who will coordinate the accountant review and follow up on unresolved donor-record issues.
next_steps: Review the 11 unsent draft(s) in Donations & Compliance and identify the records that correspond to the flagged categories.
Ask the accountant what acknowledgment wording to use for the four gifts at or above the federal threshold, including how to describe any goods or services provided.
Ask the accountant what written disclosure and good-faith valuation are needed for the payment involving goods or services, and whether an exception applies.
Ask the accountant how to describe the in-kind gift in its acknowledgment and whether it raises additional appraisal or reporting questions.
After confirming full-year gross receipts and total assets, ask the accountant which Form 990-series return applies and what deadline applies.
Ask the accountant how to document and account for the unreceived pledge and donor-restricted funds.
Confirm the foundation's registration or exemption status and applicable solicitation-registration and annual filing obligations in New York State and Connecticut.
